text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — StellarPayments is at ~85% of their monthly token quota and we've seen a steady increase in embedding requests over the last 72h. Latency p95 up from 120ms -> 290ms and error rate for /embeddings at ~1.8%. Can we coordinate a temporary quota bump + proactive comms? 

Ben: thanks for flagging. Do we have a breakdown by route? embeddings vs chat vs completions? If it's embeddings-heavy, we can bump quota quickly without touching reserved capacity.

Aisha: embeddings are ~78% of the extra usage. Completions unchanged. Also spend is trending +42% WoW; renewal touchpoint in 6 weeks so want to avoid any surprise throttles.

ops-bot: Snapshot (auto): 
```
customer: StellarPayments
period: last_72h
tokens_used: 18.7M (monthly cap: 22M)
embeddings_calls: 46k (↑210%)
embeddings_error_rate: 1.8%
embeddings_p95_latency_ms: 290
```

Carlos: Looks like tail latency spike correlates with long-sequence embedding jobs — some requests are 1k+ tokens due to batch-embedding ingestion. We could: 1) temporarily increase quota, 2) enable embeddings throttling at 10rps per account, or 3) suggest customer switch to our `embedding-fast` variant (lower cost, lower latency for long batches).

Priya: From AE side — Stellar is in expansion mode and expects sustained growth. They signed standard-seat contract; quota bumps under $X/month are OK to approve centrally — anything above we need to escalate. What's the estimated cost impact if we bump ~20%?

Ben: Estimated delta for +20% = ~$900/month (rough calc based on current unit). That's within CSM delegated approval. I'll file the quota change once we confirm messaging.

Aisha: Drafting an outbound note to the customer. Proposed messaging: short, proactive, explain root cause (ingestion batches), propose options (temporary quota bump, switch to embedding-fast, or implement client-side chunking). Draft below — pls review: 

```
Hi Team Stellar,

Quick note from your Redwood CS team: we've noticed a sharp increase in embedding volume from your account over the past 72 hours which pushed usage close to your monthly quota. To avoid any service interruptions, we can temporarily increase your token quota by 20% while you evaluate batching/chunking options. We also have an `embedding-fast` variant that reduces latency for large batch jobs — happy to coordinate a short run to compare outputs.

If you prefer, we can enable a graceful throttling policy to keep costs stable while you optimize ingestion. Please let us know which option you prefer and we can action it immediately.

Thanks,
Aisha (CSM)
```

Carlos: LGTM. Add a line offering a quick 20‑minute call to walk through `embedding-fast` tradeoffs. Also mention we can roll back the quota bump if needed.

Priya: add a note about cost transparency: include the expected $/month delta in the email so they don't get surprised.

Ben: I'll approve the +20% bump now and queue the change: `/quota adjust stellarpayments 20% --reason "customer-high-ingestion-72h"` — will run at 13:30 PT.

DeployBot: Quota update job queued by Ben at 1761234900.

Aisha: Thanks team. Action items: 1) Ben to execute bump (in progress), 2) Aisha to send the proactive email including cost delta and call offer, 3) Carlos to prepare a short `embedding-fast` runbook + perf comparison, 4) ops-bot to monitor p95/error for next 48h and alert if >2.5%.

Ben: bump completed at 1761234980. Notified billing for visibility.

ops-bot: Monitoring rule active — alert if embeddings_error_rate > 2.5% or embeddings_p95_latency_ms > 350.

Priya: I'll schedule a renewal check in 4 weeks and mark this as a potential upsell signal.

Aisha: I sent the outbound note with the cost delta and call link. I'll post any reply here. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
